# M7 results tables (exploratory; generated by scripts/analyze_paper.py — do not edit)

Archive `pilot-20261011.tar.gz` sha256 `66da0511c5879d988e49d1915461fdd3c29ab8744afde50253351d62192ac23a`; 29988 files verified. Counts are pooled over 3 seeds (seeds 1–3; 200 intents per run). Rates are per intent; recovery completion is per faulted action. 95% CIs: two-stage cluster bootstrap over seeds, or Clopper–Pearson when wider. No estimate meets the original precision target (Table 5).
